en: Ow, ow, ow, ow...
Cain!!
M-Matia...
Ugh...
Are you all right, Cain?

jp: ちょっとベッドから落ちて
en: Yeah, I'm fine. I just fell out of bed and hit my head, that's all.
Honestly, don't scare me like that.

jp: ものすごい悲鳴だったから
en: That was such a terrible scream, I was sure it was another...
Another?

jp: ううん、なんでもないわ
en: No, it's nothing.

jp: 冷めちゃったじゃないの
en: More importantly, it's already noon! The breakfast I made has gone cold.

jp: 明日はちゃんと起きるよ
en: I'll get up on time tomorrow.

jp: 昨日もそんなこと言ってたのよ
en: You said that yesterday, too.

jp: まったく、カインったら
お寝坊さんなんだから
en: Honestly, Cain, you never stop being such a sleepyhead.

jp: いつも変な夢ばかり見るから
ぐっすり眠った気がしないんだ
en: ...It's just, I keep having these strange dreams. I never feel like I've slept properly.

jp: いつものあの夢のことね
en: That same dream again?

jp: 世界が水に沈んじゃうのよね？
en: The one where a great flood comes and the world sinks under the water, right?

jp: 人も、街も、何もかもみんな
大きな波に飲み込まれるんだ
en: Yeah... People, towns, everything gets swallowed up by a huge wave.

jp: あれじゃ、誰も助からないよ
en: Everything... Nobody could survive that.

jp: それは夢の中での出来事でしょ？
en: It's all right. It only happens in your dreams, doesn't it?
Yeah...

jp: 世界が水に沈んじゃう夢じゃ
en: Oh, but today's dream wasn't the one where the world sinks.

jp: でもね、変な夢なんだよ
暗闇の中で何も見えなくて・・・
どこからか声が聞こえるんだ
en: A strange one, though. Pitch dark, couldn't see a thing... then a voice, from somewhere.

jp: 聞いたこともない声だった
誰の声だったんだろう？
なんだか・・・どこかで・・・・
en: A voice I'd never heard. Whose was it? Somehow... I feel like I've heard it before.
You are a false...
Ugh...
Cain!!
I-I'm all right...
But...

jp: 今日はまだ何も食べてないから
ちょっと、ふらついちゃっただけ
en: I haven't eaten anything yet today, so I just got a little dizzy, that's all.

jp: あぁ、もうおなかペコペコで
en: Aah, I'm so hungry I could die.
Honestly, Cain.

jp: 朝から仲むつまじい姿だな
en: How sweet, the two of you, so early in the day.

jp: 私はこのまま退散するが？
en: If I'm in the way, I could simply withdraw?

jp: いつからそこにいたんですか！？
en: Honestly, Johannes-san! How long have you been standing there!?
Only a moment.

jp: いたなら声ぐらいかけて下さい！
en: If you were there, you could have said something!

jp: 声をかけるタイミングが
なかなか掴めなかったものでね
en: I couldn't quite find the right moment to speak up.
Morning, Johannes. What brings you here today?
Good morning, Cain.

jp: 昨夜、書庫で見つけた本を
届けておこうと思ってね
en: I was out walking, and thought I'd drop off a book I found in the library last night.

jp: 確かマティアが探していた本だと
en: I believe it is the one Matia was looking for.

jp: ありがとうございます！！
en: Oh... Thank you so much!!

jp: 子供向けのやさしい本を
いくつか持ってきたのだが・・・
en: I brought a few easy children's books for Cain as well, but...
I'd rather take a nap than read a book.

jp: もう、昼寝ばっかりしてるから
ちゃんと夜に眠れなくて
en: Honestly! You nap all day, so you can't sleep at night, and then you oversleep!

jp: ベッドから落ちちゃうし
カインたら寝相も悪いのよね
en: And on top of that, you fell out of bed again. You really are a restless sleeper.

jp: 先ほどの悲鳴の正体は
en: ...I see. So that scream just now was Cain.

jp: 私はてっきり、また台所に
ネズミでも出たのかと思ったよ
en: I was certain another mouse had turned up in the kitchen.

jp: マティアはネズミが苦手だもんね
en: Matia can't stand mice, after all.

jp: しかし、フライパンを振り回して
ネズミを退治しようとするのは
衛生的にどうかと思うが・・・
en: Though swinging a frying pan around to deal with a mouse is hardly hygienic, I'd say...

jp: 持ち出さないで下さい！！
en: Stop it!! Please don't keep bringing up that old story!!
Ahahaha.

jp: 相変わらず夢見が悪いそうだが
en: By the way, Cain. I hear you are still having bad dreams. Are you feeling well?
Yeah, a little sleepy, but I'm fine.

jp: 夢は深層心理を暗示するものだ
en: ...I see. Dreams hint at what lies deep in the mind.

jp: カインのなくした記憶も
夢の中に手がかりがあるかも
en: There may be a clue to your lost memories somewhere in your dreams.
Yeah, maybe.

jp: 深く考える必要はない
記憶など放っておいても忘れて
en: There is no need to dwell on it. Memories fade on their own if you leave them be.
...Yeah.

jp: 過去の記憶を取り戻すことが
必ずしも幸せなことだとは
en: Regaining the memories of your past is not necessarily a happy thing.
Everyone has memories they would rather forget.

jp: 忘れたい記憶とか・・・
en: Do you have some too, Johannes? Memories you'd rather forget...

jp: 仮面をつけるのかもしれない
en: I suppose so... Perhaps that is why I wear a mask.
Hmm...

jp: ボクはどうなんだろう？
思い出した方がいいのかな？
それとも、このままの方が・・・
en: What about me? Would it be better to remember? Or to stay the way I am...

jp: あまり深く考えない方がいいわ
en: It's best not to think about it too deeply.

jp: そっとしておくのが一番よ
en: As long as your body doesn't want to remember, it's best to leave it alone.
Yes, quite right.

jp: 思い出なんかなくても
カインはカインなんだから
en: Even without your memories, Cain is still Cain.
...Yeah.

jp: カインの小さかった頃って
ちょっと気になるかな
en: Though... I am a little curious what Cain was like when he was small.

jp: お寝坊さんなのかしら？
en: I wonder if he was a sleepyhead back then, too?
Matia!!

jp: いつかきっと思い出せるわ
en: Hee hee, don't worry. If they're precious memories, you'll remember them someday.
I'm sure of it.
...Yeah.
Oh no!! Look at the time!!

jp: メフィストさんのところに
en: Are you going to Mephisto-san's?

jp: 今日も歌を聞かせてあげるの
en: Yes, I am. I'm going to sing for him again today.

jp: 病気は治してあげられないけど
メフィストさん、歌を聞くのが
好きみたいだから・・・
en: I can't cure his illness, but Mephisto-san seems to like listening to me sing...

jp: マティアは歌が上手だもんね
en: Matia is a good singer, after all.

jp: ボクもマティアの歌声は好きだよ
なんだか、胸のあたりがすごく
en: I love your singing too, Matia. It makes my chest feel all warm inside.
Hee hee, thank you.

jp: 雨が近いようだからな
行くなら早くした方がいいだろう
en: It seems rain is on the way. If you are going, you had best go soon.
Yes, you're right.

jp: 二人とも何を言ってるの？
雨なんて降りそうにないよ？
en: What are you two talking about? It's lovely out, it doesn't look like rain at all.

jp: 木々の葉がざわめいているの、
カインにもささやいているわ
もうすぐ雨が降る・・・
en: The leaves are rustling. They whisper it to you too, Cain. Rain is coming soon...

jp: そんなの聞こえないよ
en: I can't hear anything like that.

jp: カインにも聞こえるはずよ
en: If you try to listen, you'll hear it too, Cain.

jp: ただとても小さな声だから
ちゃんと耳をすませてあげないと
気付いてあげられないの
en: It's only a very small voice, so you won't notice it unless you really listen.

jp: 貴方にも、きっと届くはずだから
en: Try listening closely. I'm sure it will reach you, too.

jp: ボクにはどうせ無理なんだよ
en: It's no use, I can't do it.

jp: ・・・いいなぁ、マティアは
en: ...Lucky you, Matia.

jp: 不思議な力があるんだ
en: Matia has a mysterious power.

jp: 木や風の声なんて聞こえないもん
en: Not me. I can't hear the voices of the trees or the wind.
Honestly, Cain, don't sulk.

jp: 木々や風の声を聞くことが
en: Even if you can't hear the voices of the trees and the wind,

jp: 天気を読むぐらいのことなら
カインでも出来るようになる
en: with enough knowledge, even you could learn to read the weather, Cain.

jp: そうかもしれないけど
ボクは特別な力がいいんだ
en: Maybe so, but that's not it. I want a special power.

jp: ヨハネみたいに空を飛ぶことも
en: ...Because I can't fly through the sky like Johannes,

jp: 木々や風の声を聞くことも
en: and I can't hear the voices of the trees and the wind like Matia...
Honestly, Cain, you always want what you don't have.

jp: 人は自分一人しか持ちえない
特別な何かに憧れるものだ
en: People long for something special that they alone possess.

jp: そういうのって格好いいな
en: Yeah. That kind of thing is so cool.

jp: 特別な何かを持って生まれている
本人が気付かないだけでな
en: But in truth, everyone is born with something special. They simply don't notice it.
Is that true?

jp: そんな詩をどこかでみかけた
en: I recall seeing a poem to that effect somewhere.
That's not an answer at all!!

jp: ヨハネの言うことって
いっつも灰色なんだから！！！
en: ...Honestly, everything you say is always so gray, Johannes!!
Gray?

jp: 白と黒を混ぜた色だよ
ヨハネの答えはどっちでも
ない答えばかりだもん！
en: It's white and black mixed! Your answers are never one thing or the other!
I see. Well put.
All right, all right, that's enough of that.

jp: 庭のイチゴがそろそろ食べ頃
en: Cain, the strawberries in the garden are about ready to eat.

jp: 雨が降る前に摘んでおいてね
帰ってきたらジャムを作るから
en: Pick them before the rain comes, okay? I'll make jam when I get back.
Yeah, leave it to me!

jp: つまみ食いしすぎちゃダメよ
en: Don't eat too many while you're at it.

jp: たくさんジャムを作って
神父様にもお裾分けするんだから
en: I'm making lots of jam, and we're sharing some with the Father.
I know, I know.
All right then, look after the house.
Okaaay.
I shall take my leave as well.
Yeah. See you, Johannes.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
